conventions: Every new TypeScript/TSX source file must start with the standard Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026; existing modified files must keep their original copyright year.

Unit tests run in Jest (jsdom) via backstage-cli package test; in plugins/notifications use @testing-library/react screen/findBy* queries and renderInTestApp/TestApiProvider from @backstage/test-utils without data-testid attributes or real network calls; in plugins/home-react only import packages declared in plugins/home-react/package.json (such as react and react-dom/client).

decisions.topic: Live refresh via signals with polling fallback and cleanup
decisions.choice: Inside HomePageUnreadNotifications Content, subscribe with useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications'); when isSignalsAvailable is true and lastSignal updates, invoke retryRef.current(); when isSignalsAvailable is false and pollingIntervalMs > 0 (default 10000), run setInterval calling retryRef.current() and clearInterval on unmount or dependency change.
rejected: Polling unconditionally even when signals are available
Putting retry directly in useEffect dependency arrays causing re-subscription loops
decisions.reason: Satisfies real-time signal refresh when signalApiRef is registered, degrades gracefully to timer polling when unavailable, and guarantees subscription and timer cleanup on unmount.

Highlighting only in NotificationsPage without support in NotificationsTable
decisions.reason: Preserves the existing /notifications route structure while enabling both NotificationsPage and standalone NotificationsTable renders to visually and semantically highlight the targeted notification.

units.behaviour: Render the unread notifications home-page card content with live signal refresh, polling fallback, deep-linking to /notifications?id=<id>, and per-item mark-as-read.
rules: 1. Export /** @public */ type HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps = { limit?: number; pollingIntervalMs?: number } and export const Content = (props: HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps) => JSX.Element with defaults limit = 5 and pollingIntervalMs = 10000.

2. Use useTranslationRef(notificationsTranslationRef) from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha', useApi(notificationsApiRef) and useApiHolder() from '@backstage/core-plugin-api' (resolving const toastApi = apiHolder.get(toastApiRef) with toastApiRef from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api'), and resolve let notificationsRoute = '/notifications' via try { notificationsRoute = useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)(); } catch {} (with // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks).

3. Fetch unread notifications via useNotificationsApi(api => api.getNotifications({ read: false, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc', limit }), [limit]) from '../../hooks', sync value?.notifications into local useState<Notification[]>([]) in a useEffect([value]), and store retry in a ref (retryRef.current = retry) alongside an isMountedRef cleaned up on unmount.

4. Subscribe to 'notifications' signals with const { lastSignal, isSignalsAvailable } = useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications') from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react'; in a useEffect([isSignalsAvailable, lastSignal]), when isSignalsAvailable && lastSignal is truthy, call retryRef.current(); in a useEffect([isSignalsAvailable, pollingIntervalMs]), when !isSignalsAvailable && pollingIntervalMs > 0, start const timer = setInterval(() => { retryRef.current(); }, pollingIntervalMs) and return () => clearInterval(timer).

5. Render <Progress /> when loading && !value; render <ResponseErrorPanel error={error} /> when error is defined; render <Text variant="body-medium" color="secondary">{t('homePageCard.emptyMessage')}</Text> when notifications.length === 0.

6. For each notification in notifications, render a row (<Flex key={notification.id} justify="between" align="center" gap="3">) containing <SeverityIcon severity={notification.payload.severity} />, <Link to={`${notificationsRoute}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}`}>{notification.payload.title}</Link>, optional <Text variant="body-small" color="secondary">{notification.payload.description}</Text>, optional metadata (notification.origin, notification.payload.topic, and <RelativeTime value={notification.created} /> with // @ts-ignore before import RelativeTime from 'react-relative-time'), and a <ButtonIcon aria-label={t('homePageCard.markAsRead')} icon={<RiCheckboxCircleLine size={16} />} variant="secondary" onPress={() => handleMarkAsRead(notification.id)} /> that awaits notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }), removes the item from notifications state on success if still mounted, and calls toastApi?.post({ title: t('homePageCard.errors.markAsReadFailed'), status: 'danger' }) on error.

rules: 1. Import only packages declared in plugins/notifications/package.json: { act, fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react', { renderInTestApp, TestApiProvider } from '@backstage/test-utils', { signalApiRef, type SignalApi } from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react', { toastApiRef } from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api', { Notification, NotificationSignal } from '@backstage/plugin-notifications-common', and local modules (do NOT import @testing-library/user-event or @backstage/frontend-test-utils).

2. Test that Content calls notificationsApi.getNotifications({ read: false, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc', limit: 5 }) and renders notification titles, descriptions, origins, topics, and links with href='/notifications?id=<id>'.
3. Test that Content renders 'No unread notifications' when getNotifications returns an empty array and renders ResponseErrorPanel when getNotifications rejects.

4. Test that clicking the 'Mark as read' button calls notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }) and removes that notification from the DOM; test that when updateNotifications rejects, toastApi.post is called with { title: 'Failed to mark notification as read', status: 'danger' } and the notification remains.

5. Test that when signalApiRef is provided, Content subscribes to the 'notifications' channel, re-fetches unread notifications when the subscriber callback receives a NotificationSignal, and calls unsubscribe when the component unmounts.

6. Test with jest.useFakeTimers() (cleaning up with jest.useRealTimers() in afterEach) that when signalApiRef is not provided, Content polls getNotifications at pollingIntervalMs and clears the interval on unmount so advancing timers after unmount triggers no further getNotifications calls.

7. Test that NotificationsTable and NotificationsPage rendered at initial route '/notifications?id=notif-1' apply aria-current='true' and the highlightedRow class to the matching notification row and do not apply them to non-matching rows or when rendered at '/notifications' without ?id=.
